import { createContext, useContext, useRef, type CSSProperties, type ElementType, type PointerEvent, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

type Columns = 2 | 3 | 4

const ColumnsContext = createContext<Columns>(3)

const gridColumns: Record<Columns, string> = {
  2: '@2xl:grid-cols-2',
  3: '@2xl:grid-cols-3',
  4: '@2xl:grid-cols-2 @4xl:grid-cols-4',
}

// Spans are clamped to the column count so a card never spills into an implicit column.
const colSpans: Record<Columns, Record<number, string>> = {
  2: { 1: '', 2: '@2xl:col-span-2' },
  3: { 1: '', 2: '@2xl:col-span-2', 3: '@2xl:col-span-3' },
  4: { 1: '', 2: '@2xl:col-span-2', 3: '@2xl:col-span-2 @4xl:col-span-3', 4: '@2xl:col-span-2 @4xl:col-span-4' },
}

const rowSpans: Record<number, string> = { 1: '', 2: '@2xl:row-span-2', 3: '@2xl:row-span-3' }

export interface BentoGridProps {
  /** BentoCard elements. */
  children: ReactNode
  /** Columns on wide containers. The grid is one column below 672px of container width. */
  columns?: Columns
  /** Minimum height of one grid row, any CSS length. */
  rowHeight?: string
  /** Element for the grid. */
  as?: ElementType
  className?: string
}

/** Responsive bento grid. Sizes itself to its container, not the viewport. */
export function BentoGrid({ children, columns = 3, rowHeight = '13rem', as: Tag = 'div', className }: BentoGridProps) {
  return (
    <ColumnsContext.Provider value={columns}>
      <div className="@container w-full">
        <Tag
          style={{ '--bento-row': rowHeight } as CSSProperties}
          className={cn(
            'grid grid-flow-dense grid-cols-1 auto-rows-[minmax(var(--bento-row),auto)] gap-3',
            gridColumns[columns],
            className,
          )}
        >
          {children}
        </Tag>
      </div>
    </ColumnsContext.Provider>
  )
}

export interface BentoCardProps {
  /** Card heading. Also the accessible name of the link or button. */
  title: ReactNode
  /** Short copy under the title. */
  description?: ReactNode
  /** Small icon before the title. */
  icon?: ReactNode
  /** Decorative artwork above the copy; fills the free space and fades out at the bottom. Use `group-hover/bento:` classes inside it to react to hover. */
  visual?: ReactNode
  /** Columns the card spans on wide containers. Clamped to the grid's column count. */
  colSpan?: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4
  /** Rows the card spans on wide containers. */
  rowSpan?: 1 | 2 | 3
  /** Makes the whole card a link. */
  href?: string
  /** Makes the whole card a button when there is no href. */
  onClick?: () => void
  /** Small call to action under the copy, e.g. "Learn more". Shown on interactive cards only. */
  cta?: ReactNode
  /** Element for the heading. */
  titleAs?: ElementType
  className?: string
}

/** One tile of a BentoGrid. Lifts on hover, moves its visual and shows a pointer-following glow. */
export function BentoCard({
  title,
  description,
  icon,
  visual,
  colSpan = 1,
  rowSpan = 1,
  href,
  onClick,
  cta,
  titleAs: Title = 'h3',
  className,
}: BentoCardProps) {
  const columns = useContext(ColumnsContext)
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const span = Math.min(colSpan, columns)
  const interactive = href != null || onClick != null

  // Glow follows the mouse only; touch and pen never set it.
  const onPointerMove = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (e.pointerType !== 'mouse' || !ref.current) return
    const r = ref.current.getBoundingClientRect()
    ref.current.style.setProperty('--bento-x', `${e.clientX - r.left}px`)
    ref.current.style.setProperty('--bento-y', `${e.clientY - r.top}px`)
  }

  // Stretched link/button: the heading stays a heading, its control covers the card.
  const stretched =
    "rounded-[inherit] after:absolute after:inset-0 after:z-20 after:rounded-[inherit] after:content-[''] focus-visible:outline-none"
  const label = href ? (
    <a href={href} onClick={onClick} className={stretched}>
      {title}
    </a>
  ) : onClick ? (
    <button type="button" onClick={onClick} className={cn(stretched, 'cursor-pointer text-left')}>
      {title}
    </button>
  ) : (
    title
  )

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      onPointerMove={onPointerMove}
      className={cn(
        'group/bento relative isolate flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-card text-card-foreground',
        'transition-[translate,box-shadow,border-color] duration-300 ease-out hover:border-foreground/15 hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-foreground/5',
        'motion-safe:hover:-translate-y-1',
        'has-[:focus-visible]:ring-2 has-[:focus-visible]:ring-ring has-[:focus-visible]:ring-offset-2 has-[:focus-visible]:ring-offset-background',
        colSpans[columns][span],
        rowSpans[rowSpan],
        className,
      )}
    >
      {visual != null && (
        <div aria-hidden className="pointer-events-none relative -z-10 min-h-28 flex-1 overflow-hidden @2xl:min-h-0">
          <div className="absolute inset-0 [mask-image:linear-gradient(to_bottom,black_55%,transparent)] transition-transform duration-500 ease-out motion-safe:group-hover/bento:-translate-y-1 motion-safe:group-hover/bento:scale-[1.03]">
            {visual}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      <div
        aria-hidden
        className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 -z-10 opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-300 [background:radial-gradient(22rem_circle_at_var(--bento-x,50%)_var(--bento-y,0%),color-mix(in_oklab,var(--primary)_12%,transparent),transparent_70%)] [@media(hover:hover)_and_(pointer:fine)]:group-hover/bento:opacity-100"
      />
      <div className={cn('flex flex-col gap-1.5 p-5', visual != null ? 'pt-3' : 'mt-auto')}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          {icon != null && (
            <span
              aria-hidden
              className="inline-flex size-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-border bg-background/70 text-foreground [&_svg]:size-3.5"
            >
              {icon}
            </span>
          )}
          <Title className="min-w-0 text-base font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground">{label}</Title>
        </div>
        {description != null && <p className="max-w-md text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>}
        {cta != null && interactive && (
          <span
            aria-hidden
            className="mt-1 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-sm font-medium text-primary"
          >
            {cta}
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" className="size-3.5 transition-transform duration-300 motion-safe:group-hover/bento:translate-x-0.5">
              <path d="M6 3.5 10.5 8 6 12.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
            </svg>
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { Accessibility, Braces, Keyboard, Moon, Palette, Terminal } from 'lucide-react'
import { BentoCard, BentoGrid } from '@/components/bento-grid'

const tileShades = ['bg-primary', 'bg-primary/60', 'bg-primary/25', 'bg-muted', 'bg-primary/40', 'bg-primary/80', 'bg-muted', 'bg-primary/15']

function Mosaic() {
  return (
    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-wrap content-start gap-1.5 p-5">
      {Array.from({ length: 96 }, (_, i) => (
        <span
          key={i}
          style={{ transitionDelay: `${(i % 24) * 15}ms` }}
          className={`size-5 rounded-[4px] transition-transform duration-500 motion-safe:group-hover/bento:-translate-y-1 ${tileShades[(i * 5 + (i >> 3)) % tileShades.length]}`}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

function Keycaps() {
  const key = 'flex h-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-border bg-background font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground shadow-[0_2px_0_0] shadow-border transition-transform duration-300'
  return (
    <div className="absolute inset-x-5 top-6 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
      <span className={`${key} col-span-2`}>Tab</span>
      <span className={key}>Esc</span>
      <span className={key}>⇧</span>
      <span className={`${key} border-primary/50 text-primary motion-safe:group-hover/bento:translate-y-0.5 motion-safe:group-hover/bento:shadow-none`}>
        ↵
      </span>
      <span className={key}>⌥</span>
      <span className={`${key} col-span-3`}>Space</span>
      <span className={key}>←</span>
      <span className={key}>↓</span>
      <span className={key}>→</span>
    </div>
  )
}

function TerminalLines() {
  return (
    <div className="absolute inset-x-5 top-5 space-y-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border bg-background/80 p-3 font-mono text-[11px] leading-none text-muted-foreground">
      <p>
        <span className="text-primary">$</span> npx shadcn add mozaik/bento-grid
      </p>
      <p className="transition-opacity duration-500 group-hover/bento:text-foreground">✓ bento-grid.tsx</p>
    </div>
  )
}

function Wave() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 200 60" fill="none" className="absolute inset-x-5 top-6 h-14 w-[calc(100%-2.5rem)]" preserveAspectRatio="none">
      <path
        d="M0 30 C 20 5, 40 5, 60 30 S 100 55, 120 30 S 160 5, 200 30"
        className="stroke-primary/70 transition-opacity duration-500 group-hover/bento:opacity-0"
        strokeWidth="2"
      />
      <path
        d="M0 30 H 200"
        className="stroke-foreground/40 opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-500 group-hover/bento:opacity-100"
        strokeWidth="2"
        strokeDasharray="4 6"
      />
    </svg>
  )
}

function Eclipse() {
  return (
    <div className="absolute right-6 top-3 size-16">
      <span className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full bg-primary/80 blur-[1px]" />
      <span className="absolute inset-0 translate-x-3 -translate-y-1.5 rounded-full bg-card transition-transform duration-700 ease-out motion-safe:group-hover/bento:translate-x-6" />
    </div>
  )
}

function CodeLines() {
  const line = 'h-2 rounded-full'
  return (
    <div className="absolute inset-x-5 top-6 space-y-2.5 font-mono">
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <span className={`${line} w-12 bg-primary/70`} />
        <span className={`${line} w-24 bg-foreground/50`} />
        <span className={`${line} w-6 bg-muted-foreground/40`} />
      </div>
      <div className="flex gap-2 pl-6">
        <span className={`${line} w-16 bg-foreground/30`} />
        <span className={`${line} w-28 bg-primary/40 transition-[width] duration-500 motion-safe:group-hover/bento:w-40`} />
      </div>
      <div className="flex gap-2 pl-6">
        <span className={`${line} w-20 bg-foreground/30`} />
        <span className={`${line} w-14 bg-muted-foreground/40`} />
      </div>
      <span className={`${line} block w-4 bg-muted-foreground/40`} />
    </div>
  )
}

export default function BentoGridDemo() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-4xl">
      <BentoGrid rowHeight="11rem">
        <BentoCard
          colSpan={2}
          icon={<Palette />}
          title="Tokens, not hex"
          description="Every color comes from your theme, so blocks follow light and dark."
          visual={<Mosaic />}
          href="#"
        />
        <BentoCard
          rowSpan={2}
          icon={<Keyboard />}
          title="Keyboard first"
          description="Real links and buttons, visible focus rings, sensible tab order."
          visual={<Keycaps />}
          href="#"
          cta="Try it"
        />
        <BentoCard icon={<Terminal />} title="One command" description="Install straight into your repo." visual={<TerminalLines />} href="#" />
        <BentoCard icon={<Accessibility />} title="Reduced motion" description="Calm, static frames on request." visual={<Wave />} href="#" />
        <BentoCard icon={<Moon />} title="Dark by default" description="Tuned for dark, fine in light." visual={<Eclipse />} href="#" />
        <BentoCard
          colSpan={2}
          icon={<Braces />}
          title="Typed props"
          description="Strict TypeScript and one shared API across every component."
          visual={<CodeLines />}
          href="#"
        />
      </BentoGrid>
    </div>
  )
}
